messages:
deploy-bot: Canary rollout started for release r-2026.03.20 (canary=5%). Command: `/deploy start r-2026.03.20 --canary 5%`
jen: Quick heads-up — backout criteria: latency spike p95 > 400ms, error rate > 2%, or CSI alert. Runbook: https://confluence.internal/release/backout-runbook
maria: I'm primary oncall for the next 30m, watching SLOs and traces. Tom will be secondary and own the pin swap if we need to unwind.
sam: Preflight checklist (keeping short):
- Pause traffic endpoint available: `/deploy pause r-2026.03.20`
- Pin previous artifact: use API `/pins` to set `service/model -> v1.14`
- Drain new pods with `kubectl drain --grace-period=60`
- Verify health endpoints + hit counts after pin
lia: Copying runbook snippet for quick rollback: 
```
# Quick backout (run as infra user)
./bin/fallback --release r-2026.03.20 --target v1.14
# verify
curl -sS http://internal-health/service | jq .status
# confirm no pending migrations
./bin/db-check-migrations --release r-2026.03.20
```
jen: Who will own the external comms and release notes update if we backout? Sam can you draft the stub so we can post quickly?
sam: Yep, I'll draft postmortem stub and update release notes. Jen — please hand off the pin token from Vault to me (approle).
jen: Handing off now: vault path `secret/releases/r-2026.03.20/pin-token` granted to @sam approle for 20m :white_check_mark: — confirm once you have it.
sam: I have the token, verified.
maria: Important: if rollback touches DB migrations, do NOT run automatic migration rollback. That path is manual and must go via DBA approval. Add @dba-oncall if we go there.
tom: Also note: if we need to kill tasks, use graceful drain + `--allow-failures` only for non-critical jobs. For critical jobs escalate.
jen: tagging change window: `CW-2026-03-20-01` — documented in change calendar.
sam: Ready to execute pin swap if needed. I will post status updates to #status and ping product.
maria: Final rule for this canary: if we see sustained p95 > 300ms for 3 consecutive 1m windows, call `UNWIND` in this channel and we execute backout.
lia: Current metrics: p50=120ms, p95=240ms, errors=0.3% — looks good, continue watching for 10m.
deploy-bot: Canary metrics poll: p50=118ms, p95=238ms, errors=0.28% (t=10m)
jen: Copy — keeping channel open. If anyone executes backout, add a short reason line and runbook step id you followed.
sam: If I run the pin: `/api/pins set service/model v1.14 --reason "canary unwind"` then I will announce completion and smoke test.
maria: If unwind occurs, open critical incident with template `incident-templates/backout` and set severity=2. Attach logs and timeline.
jen: acknowledged. staging smoke passed. Holding for final 10m before promoting to 50%.
deploy-bot: Canary complete at 12m without anomalies. Recommendation: promote to 50% in 10m unless other flags raised.
